**Amazon Commission** is

G/L No : 244001

DE Code : 1968

MG Code : 53153 (unless Practical Lifestyle title which is 53161. Note that we are not actively selling PL items on Amazon).

NA Code : 244

Dim_5 Code : PMarketplace or DMarketplace depending on whether the items sold was Print (includes combo) or Digital.

**Amazon FBA** is

G/L No : 232002

DE Code : 1994

MG Code : 53153 (unless Practical Lifestyle title which is 53161. Note that we are not actively selling PL items on Amazon).

NA Code : 232

Dim_5 Code : PMarketplace or DMarketplace depending on whether the items sold was Print (includes combo) or Digital. This could also be PWeb if the item was sold on our website, but fulfilled by Amazon.
